entities.summary: Azerbaijan National Resistance Organization (ANRO) (AMDT) was officially founded in 2006. The group defines itself as a part and subset of general National Movement of South Azerbaijan and advocates separatism for the Iranian Azerbaijanis as a result of their Pan-Turkist ideology.
